item.title: [Peter Yang] Antigravity 手机遥控小技巧：把网页加到主屏幕
item.description:
@petergyang · 查看 X 原推文 ↗

中文翻译

给正在用 @antigravity 玩 Neon 的朋友们，分享一个快速小技巧：

1. 打开 https://t.co/GRhlnGkO1i 2. 点“查看更多”，再点分享按钮 3. 点“添加到主屏幕”

这样你就能在手机上像遥控器一样，跟 Antigravity 里所有的对话线程聊天了。

虽然 Antigravity 还没有手机 App，但我觉得它的遥控功能其实比 Claude 的更好用，因为所有线程默认都能直接访问。

英文原推文

For those of you trying out @antigravity for Neon, here's a quick tip:

1. Go to https://t.co/GRhlnGkO1i 2. Tap see more and then the share button 3. Tap Add to Home Screen

Then you can talk to all your Antigravity threads via remote control on mobile.

Even though Antigravity doesn't have a mobile app (yet), I find its remote control actually better than Claude's because all the threads are available by default.

Now, @agentcardhq exists, models are better, iMessage and WhatsApp eve channels are mature, and performance is vastly improved (without trading off durability and encryption.)
